run.decision: FAIL / VALIDATION_FAIL. The official Cboe PUT cash-secured put-write index proxy produced 6.377166% CAGR, 0.513029 Sharpe and 41.153996% MDD over the continuous 2007-2026 window, with 6/7 positive-Sharpe folds. Matched SPY total return produced 10.184584% CAGR, 0.594088 Sharpe and 59.225176% MDD. PUT lowers drawdown but still breaches the <=25% absolute MDD floor and does not improve Sharpe, so validation/objective/comparison all FAIL. Global DSR=1.4994209e-05. Actual monthly SPX option commission/slippage evidence is also missing, so this proxy could not have exceeded WEAK even if absolute gates had passed. No option-parameter rescue is allowed.

methodology.follow_up_policy: After any formal metric is viewed, do not switch option benchmark, moneyness, maturity, dynamic condition or blend weights. A promising PUT result may proceed only to a separately preregistered execution study using real historical option quotes/cost assumptions.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
external wrapper max gross <=100% and cash >=0
methodology.selection_metric: No option-parameter search. Exact official Cboe PUT index only. Compare to matched-window SPY adjusted-close total-return proxy. Absolute historical gates, high-return objective and SPY comparison are separate; even an absolute PASS is capped at validation=WEAK because execution costs inside monthly option rolls are not modeled.

run.title: put-index-proxy-001 / Cboe现金担保PutWrite001; option volatility-risk-premium index proxy

strategies.description: Selling fully cash-secured one-month ATM SPX put options against a Treasury-bill/cash collateral account can harvest the volatility risk premium and may deliver better risk-adjusted returns and lower drawdown than long-only SPY total return without borrowed exposure. The Cboe PUT benchmark provides a clean structural proxy for this economic rule, but because the benchmark omits actual investor implementation costs this trial can establish only index-proxy evidence, not product execution validity.

allowed_changes: use only official Cboe PUT_History.csv frozen SHA
ignore pre-2007 sparse anchor rows and use continuous daily segment beginning 2007-01-03
use matched SPY adjusted-close total-return proxy over exact common evaluation window
convert both USD series with the same historical usd_per_cny path
apply identical external acquisition cost of 1.00% fee +0.05% slippage to both proxy series
forbidden_changes: BXM, BXMD, PUTW, PUTR, conditional or dynamic option index substitution after results
changing put delta, moneyness, expiration, roll schedule or adding VIX timing
blending PUT with SPY/TLT/gold after results
treating Cboe index as proof of real execution costs
using pre-2007 sparse observations to extend headline history
changing SPY control to S&P price index
